依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险，传说山中埋着千年女尸，千年不灭之阴火，进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半，依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间，依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间，更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

titles.value: 我爱神仙遮 / My Darling Genie

descriptions.value: 推土车司机阿成，在工作时忽遇地陷而堕入一地下古庙，无意中成为油纸伞妖的主人。她更将自己现身的秘密及超凡的法力告知阿成。地盘工目凡叔嗜赌，欠下恶少高利贷，恶少垂涎凡叔之女美色，要凡叔以女还债；阿成得悉后请伞妖戏弄恶少，并暗助凡叔在赌场获胜，清还债项。惟此神伞之秘密却被恶少发现…
当年轻母亲为女儿莫名失踪而苦恼时，一连串怪异的事件接踵而至。这都可能与二十年前的意外亡魂为复仇归来有关…
咏春大师叶问的功夫在中国各地备受推崇。正值日本侵华，叶问被迫离开家园并要找工作养家糊口。他唯有无奈地以咏春拳教导学生自卫训练，以赚取生活费用。
设计师赵宇庭被批算三十岁前结婚，会被妻子克死，赵父遂严禁赵宇庭结交异性。但限期将届，他急不及待觅对象。荔玲与母亲同为死人化妆师，为了交男友改为新娘化妆，此时她认识了赵宇庭...
波子一夜用望远镜窥看家邻近四周时，揭发了一宗命案。但经警方调查村内居民，包括富商情妇Rita、邮差、纸店主老王及其妻子等人，揭开彼此间错综复杂的情欲关系之同时，还是不知谁是受害人，谁是凶手… 于是，波子决定用自己的方法继续调查…

titles.value: 千王斗千霸 / Challenge of the Gamesters

descriptions.value: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。
三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭借精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

titles.value: 龙的传人 / Legend Of The Dragon

descriptions.value: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展。他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注。小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注。小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？
城中著名的「盗贼三人组」受聘以3000万元绑架一名婴孩。当他们发现黑帮不仅企图吞掉赎金，更要置婴孩于死地后，决定担起保护婴孩的责任，并护送他平安回家。一方面要躲避警方追捕，另一方面又遭黑帮穷追不舍，三人即使危机四伏，仍誓死守护婴孩。

titles.value: 一眉道人 / Vampire Vs Vampire

descriptions.value: 一眉道长与徒弟隐居于偏远村庄。某日，玛利亚修女计划重建一座荒废已久的教堂，却意外唤醒沉睡多年的僵尸黑袍传教士。全镇顿时陷入恐慌，面对传统茅山术失效的绝境，一眉道长唯有与西方驱魔神父连手，融合中西驱魔之法，展开一场惊心动魄的驱魔大战。

descriptions.value: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死。意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债。

titles.value: 逃学威龙三之龙过鸡年 / Fight Back to School III

descriptions.value: 富商王百万被发现离奇死于酒店房间，由于周星星与他极为相似，星星再次接受任务，作卧底调查这宗谋杀案。王百万生前与妻子感情早已破裂，妻子因此成为头号嫌疑人。然而，在调查过程中，星星发现王百万的友人林大岳同样形迹可疑……

titles.value: 风流冤鬼 / Sex Beyond The Grave

descriptions.value: 红歌女阿花遭大户陶老爷奸杀，陶宅即常闹鬼，后陶老爷亦神秘死亡。陶之后人陶明嗜赌如命，更因鬼魂作怪而欠下巨款。明妻暗中将陶宅售予杨教授夫妇，即遇上怪事连篇...

titles.value: 少年陈真之乱世英雄 / Young Heroes of Chaotic Times

descriptions.value: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事。
书生王怀卿卖画，为要筹药费救患重病的妻子，途中意外遇上雀妖的追击，幸得狐妖小容相救。为躲避雀妖，王怀卿将小容带回家中，三人随即陷入一场情感困局，而一段凄美的人妖虐恋亦随即展开。
这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅。曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人。当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒。最后他能否杀出重围？

titles.value: 少年叶问之危机时刻 / Young Ip Man: Crisis Time

descriptions.value: 1917年，少年叶问初到香港求学。英文演讲比赛当天，学校发生一宗惊天绑架案，全校同学都被挟持。面对眼前的危机，叶问挺身而出，发现绑匪竟然是自己的师父和好兄弟。少年叶问在危机时刻可否打败绑匪，从而伸张正义？
偷渡到东京的铁头与一帮华人在当地艰难求生，并逐渐建立起一股黑帮新势力。当铁头取得居留权，决心退出江湖、展开新生活时，势力的急速扩张却引来各方势力围剿。面对警方大举扫黑，加上兄弟无情出卖，他最终被迫重返江湖。

titles.value: 六耳猕猴 / The Macaque Monkey

descriptions.value: 生命之树被烧毁后，世间陷入一片混沌。为拯救苍生，孙悟空决定回到过去，帮助生命之树复活。因为失去了金箍棒，孙悟空力量时有时无，只得找回儿时的自己，一同前往寻找时间之力。不料，六耳猕猴却想据为己有，两人就此爆发激战。

titles.value: 追女三十六房 / 36 Secrets of Courtship

descriptions.value: 故事描述一间「猛男训练中心」专门教授男人在情场上的杀着。可惜校长与其女友缠绵时不幸暴毙，学校三位教授想出招数争夺学校拥有权，闹出连场笑话...

titles.value: 天官赐福 / How to Choose a Royal Bride

descriptions.value: 康熙少年嗣位，太后急欲替他完婚，遂选纳大臣之女纳兰琼瑶为妃，但琼瑶为争取婚姻自由离家出走，康熙亦乐得不用成婚。后来康熙微服下江南，却偶遇女扮男装的琼瑶…

titles.value: 黑白潜行 / The Grey Men

descriptions.value: 警校生阿山奉命卧底监狱，接近犯罪集团二把手阿天，暗中搜集其犯罪证据。阿天出狱后，阿山协助他以铁血手段一路厮杀，最终登上社团话事人之位。然而，阿山频繁与警方接触的行迹逐渐败露，卧底身份被社团识破，瞬间陷入生死危局，而一个足以颠覆一切的秘密也即将浮出水面。

titles.value: 爱的世界 / The Story Of My Son

descriptions.value: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命。妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离。与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生…

Entrepreneur Michael Lee from ‪the Republic of Korea‬ came to China in 2003. More than two decades later, he now calls Quanzhou in Fujian Province his home. titles.value: Guangdong Expands Opening Up to Connect with Asia-Pacific

descriptions.value:
Guangdong Province has long been one of China's pioneers in opening up. As the country's leading provincial trader, Guangdong is deepening economic ties with the Asia-Pacific through trade, innovation and closer cooperation. From coffee machines made in Shunde to robots developed through Guangdong-Hong Kong collaboration, companies are finding new opportunities across the region.
The province has been China's largest provincial trader for 40 years, with last year's imports and exports topping 9 trillion yuan (about 1.3 trillion US dollars) and more than 20 million market entities. Shunde is now the world's largest coffee machine production base, with Gemilai alone shipping to over 60 countries and selling more than two million units. Leveraging the Greater Bay Area's innovation hub, Guangdong is also advancing Guangdong-Hong Kong robotics projects and, as Shenzhen hosts APEC this year, aims to deepen regional industrial and supply-chain links for shared growth.

titles.value: Shared Future for Asia Pacific: Best-selling hair dryer highlights strengths of southern China's cross-border supply chain

descriptions.value: As China hosts APEC 2026, regional integration is taking center stage. In southern China's Greater Bay Area, cities like Zhuhai, Hengqin, and Macao are operating like a single supply chain network, linking automated factories with global talent and capital. To see how this cross-border teamwork helps brands go global, CGTN's Yu Hongyu takes us inside a hair dryer factory in Zhuhai.

descriptions.value: Once a fishing town, Shenzhen is now a city where emerging technologies move quickly from concept to daily life. Our reporter Wang Tianyu explores what powers that transformation. Take a look.

titles.value: From bikes to your phone: Carbon fiber weaves the Asia-Pacific

descriptions.value: Carbon fiber-once reserved for aerospace and elite racing-is now powering a much broader industrial shift across the Asia-Pacific. In southern China, Guangdong province is turning lower-cost mass production into a major export advantage. CGTN's Yu Hongyu explores how this featherlight thread is is driving billions in APEC trade.

You flip a switch, and the lights come on. But where does that power come from? In Yangjiang, Guangdong, the answer lies offshore. The city leads all of China's prefecture-level cities in offshore wind capacity, backed by a growing industrial chain spanning turbine manufacturing, testing and operations. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun takes you inside China's offshore wind industry and explores how it is helping power the Asia-Pacific's green transition.

titles.value: From receptionist to manager: Elizabeth's 8-year journey at a Chinese firm

descriptions.value:
Elizabeth Lindon, a 46-year-old from Papua New Guinea, is now a senior supervisor at BNBM PNG in Port Moresby. Over eight years, she has worked her way up from office receptionist to forklift operator--breaking the stereotype that operating forklifts is "a man's job"--and then moving into management. Her journey shows how China-APEC cooperation translates into real benefits for individuals and families.

titles.value: How a Chinese company helped Danang's tofu business thrive in Indonesia

descriptions.value:
Pak Danang makes tofu in Mendis Village, Indonesia. He once had no license and no steady buyers -- until China Datang Power Plant stepped in with hygiene training, permits, soybeans and a supply deal with a company cafeteria. His monthly income has since jumped from IDR 12 million to 42 million ($2,300). 
A livelihood transformed, one block of tofu at a time. This is China-APEC cooperation made real!

titles.value: A Bite of China IV Ep.6

descriptions.value: The fourth series of ‘A Bite of China’ takes a deep dive into seven often-overlooked culinary realms: handcrafted street snacks, local eateries, county flavors, food markets, farms, kitchens and restaurants. In short, it’s a documentary series that makes an invaluable contribution to the chronicling of China’s collective food memory.
Literati such as Lu You, Li Yu, Yuan Mei, and Wang Zengqi take center stage as we explore their worlds and works through the flavors and cuisine of daily life.

In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor "Sun Quan seitan". In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with "gray soup rice dumplings", while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he's ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

CGTN's integrated media cultural and travel program "China Untapped: Suzhou" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou's high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou's urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou's industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing's northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

titles.value: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun

descriptions.value: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. The Corban Festival began here with the arrival of Islam in the 7th century AD, and has developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar, just as important as Spring Festival. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

titles.value: PODCAST: When influencer culture meets ancient lakeside town - the changing face of Dali

descriptions.value: Filming at a lakeside village in China's picturesque Dali prefecture, Travelogue hosts Tianran He, Jack Klumpp and Alex McCutcheon find themselves at an establishment that is two parts coffee house, eight parts photography studio, swarming with professional photographers and dedicated influencers all striving for that perfect cover photo against the shimmering Erhai Lake. They reflect on the almost mystical allure that has led travelers, past and present, to fall in love with Dali and never want to leave. Over an elegantly served Americano, they discuss how coffee production, redevelopment, and modern tourism trends are reshaping this idyllic corner of the world.

Perhaps there’s no place that epitomises the cultural grandeur of China’s central plains than Henan. A cradle of Chinese civilization, abounding with resources and talented people, this is a place that has thousands of years of history in every corner. And what better opportunity to get the lowdown from on high on the cultural jewel that is Henan than by joining us on Aerial China IV…
